alert.title: Mayor Mary Sheffield backs Abdul El-Sayed in U.S. Senate race - Detroit Free Press

finding: Exact Free Press body/canonical URL/publication date were not retrieved; alert RSS open was inaccessible. Whether Mayor Mary Sheffield endorsed El-Sayed, the date of any such endorsement, and whether the alert reports a new event remain unverified. No poll evidence found. Do not adopt classifier directional claim.

official_campaign_source.facts: Campaign release dated Nov13 2025 states Rev. Horace Sheffield III endorsed El-Sayed on Nov8 2025 and identifies Mary Sheffield as his daughter, then mayor-elect. This is a different person and is not evidence of a Mary Sheffield endorsement.

official_search: Campaign-domain search for Mary Sheffield endorsement and Detroit city-domain search for El-Sayed/Sheffield found no matching statement; this does not establish that no endorsement exists.
poll_context: No new survey identified. Marist 50–48, fielded Oct15–18, was already included as poll 7 in the Oct22 eight-poll model; debate/endorsement timing does not change that cohort.
